speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Hello there. How are you today?

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: I am fine. Just thinking over things.

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Have you ever heard of Save the Children?

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: I may have. Can you tell me more?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Save the Children is a charitable organization that promotes children's rights. They also provide relief for children in regions subject to violence and civil unrest, and aid for needy children in developing countries.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: How did you learn about them?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: I originally found out about them when someone talked to me about donating to them. Most of what I know about them comes from reading about them online.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: What countries do they help in?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: They help children in 120 different countries, including the USA and most African, South American, and Asian countries.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Are donations made securely and safely?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: They are. Save the Children is a very highly rated charity, rated 88.3 out of 100 by Charity Navigator in 2016. They also disclose all of their financial information online, to promote transparency in how they spend the money donated to them.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: How much of the donation goes to the child?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: 86% of donations go into programs to help children. Administrative costs are only about 5% of donations, with the remainder going towards fundraising efforts.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Is that a good amount? How much can I donate?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: 5% is a rather low administrative cost for a charity, which is good. And the portion that goes to fundraising generates more donations than the money put into it, so it overall increases the money that gets to those who need it. And any donation helps, even something as low as one or two dollars.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: What can one to two dollars buy for a child in need?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: It depends of course on the region where the child being helped is located. But in some of the poorer parts of the world, a dollar can buy a few days worth of healthy food, or buy an item of clothing for a child who needs it.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: Can I donate one dollar?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Yes, a 1 dollar donation is perfectly acceptable, and greatly appreciated.

speaker: A2N962G55T9MOB
text: I want to donate one dollar.

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Excelent! Thank you very much for your donation.
